reddit.title: Exciting Updates to Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse CA system, ponds are now more efficient and responsive to changes in the landscape. No more freezing frames when turning on a well! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water Mechanics Overhaul in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to announce a major update to our water mechanics. With the new native sparse CA system, water now interacts more dynamically with the terrain. Ponds are easier to manage, and wells function smoothly without freezing the game. For a deep dive into the changes, read more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
